essence: Certain images of Hari are indeed animate.
Hari's purifying forms are of two kinds, including the śālagrāma.
The best forms are tenfold and arranged in successive order.
The forms are sequentially characterized as clay-born and variegated.
The mentioned forms are distinguished as movable and immovable.
